title: The model book
contentsMargin: Rules are grouped by theme. Within each theme, the rules still waiting for evidence come first.
licence: The model rules and their words are CC BY 4.0. Each dataset keeps its own licence, listed on the sources page.
intro1: This book is the whole of the model behind Yfory. Every rule is written as data, with a kind, its inputs and output, a lag, parameters with a range, a confidence and the sources behind it.
intro2: Any parameter with a dial can be changed. The game then plays your version, and says so on every screen until you put the rules back.
placeholders: {n} of the {of} rules are placeholders: they ship so the game hangs together, but their evidence is thin or missing. They are marked wherever they appear.
missing.title: There is no such page
missing.body: That page is not in the model book. The contents lists every rule and section.
kind.linear: Linear: the output moves in step with its input, by a fixed amount for each unit.
kind.saturating: Saturating: each play helps less than the last, or the total stops at a ceiling.
kind.stock: Stock: a quantity that carries from term to term, with inflows and outflows.
kind.threshold: Threshold: nothing happens until a level is crossed, then an event fires by chance.
kind.fcm: Cognitive map: pressures and states from the SoNaRR model push on each other until they settle.
kind.io: Input-output: spending ripples into jobs through the Wales input-output tables.
evidence.assessed: Assessed: in SoNaRR or official statistics.
rule.placeholder: Placeholder. This rule ships so the game hangs together, but the evidence behind it is thin. Treat it as a question, not an answer.
rule.gameRule: Game rule. This is a design choice that keeps the game fair, not a claim about Wales.
rule.lagNone: Takes effect in the same term
rule.paramsIntro: Each run of the game samples these within their range. Move a dial to set the central value. The small triangle marks the default.
slider.fixed: Fixed at {v}. A rule of the game, not open to change.
slider.changed: Changed by you. The default is {v}.
slider.placeholder: This value is a placeholder awaiting evidence.
indicators.title: Indicators and bands
indicators.blurb: The real measures, their latest values and how each is scored.
indicators.margin: Bands come from model/bands.yaml. Where there is no band, the measure is context only.
indicators.intro: Each measure is a real figure for every authority. To join a strand it is scored from 0 to 10 against a reference band: the value that scores 0 and the value that scores 10.
strands.title: Strands and how they are made
strands.blurb: The seven goals, and the measures that wind each one.
strands.margin: Flow feeds Lived, stock feeds Left. The result is the lower of the two.
strands.intro: Each strand is one of the seven well-being goals. Its flow says how people fare now; its stock says what is handed on. Each is the average of the parts listed.
cards.title: Cards
cards.blurb: Every policy lever in the deck, as a railway ticket.
cards.margin: Stock colour is the scope: buff national, green region, pink two regions, blue standing.
cards.intro: The levers you can pull in Yfory. Each costs pips from the term’s budget and pays out after a delay. Read only here.
curveballs.title: Curveballs
curveballs.blurb: Events from the horizon scan, and what prepares you for them.
curveballs.margin: Curveballs come from horizon-scan trends. A shock can only come from a trend already on the table.
curveballs.intro: The slow trends and sudden shocks Yfory can deal you. Read only here.
sources.title: Sources
sources.blurb: Every dataset and paper, with its licence.
sources.margin: Licences marked “verify” are believed open but not yet confirmed on the publisher’s page.
sources.intro: Where every figure and rule comes from. Each dataset keeps its own licence.
changed.title: Your changes
changed.none: You have not changed any parameter. The game plays the default rule set.
changed.intro: These parameters differ from the default. Games started now play this modified rule set.
attributions.title: Attributions and licences
attributions.blurb: The exact credit each dataset asks for, and its licence.
attributions.intro: Every dataset this game and atlas draw on, with the acknowledgement its publisher asks for, word for word, and the licence it is released under. The acknowledgements are kept in their original wording.
attributions.margin: The Open Government Licence v3.0 asks for an acknowledgement of the source and a link to the licence. Each entry gives both.
attributions.logos: Logos and third party material are not covered by these licences and are not used.
attributions.checkedOn: Checked on 26 November 2026 against each publisher’s own page. This records what each publisher states and is not legal advice.
attributions.unconfirmed: No licence is stated for this table. Written confirmation has been requested; the figures stay flagged until it arrives.
